slides.texte_overlay:
Things to learn before your
first serious relationship
How to manage your own stress. A partner isn't a therapist. Training, friends, journaling. Handling your own bad days keeps the relationship light.
How to handle money together. Talk early about spending, saving and splitting costs. Money problems hurt many couples who never talked about it.
How to keep your friendships. Don't disappear into the relationship. Your friends were there before and they'll keep you balanced.
How to show love in small ways. A coffee in the morning, a message during her busy day. Small attention matters more than big gestures.
Before: I had nothing new to share on dates. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and our conversations never get boring.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I had nothing new to share on dates. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Our conversations never get boring.

slides.texte_overlay: How to take responsibility for your moods. Don't make her guess what's wrong. Say "I'm tired, it's not about you" and the evening stays good.
How to grow together. Plan things to learn and try as a couple. A trip, a class, a new sport. Shared growth keeps a relationship alive.
